subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this PR be rebased into the current composer context-usage control, or should maintainers treat the current main implementation plus the broader token-visibility tracker as superseding this separate 2px meter?
rationale: Current main already has a richer context usage surface, while this protected/member PR proposes a distinct UI treatment that automation should not accept or close without maintainer intent.

options.title: Rebase into current context control
options.body: Keep the idea, but move it into ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer.ts using getContextNoticeViewModel and existing stale-state tests.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Treat current main's context usage control and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/62167 as the maintained path, and close this stale branch manually.

options.title: Sponsor a separate meter
options.body: Accept a second visible composer meter only with explicit UX direction and tests proving it does not conflict with the existing context control.

recommendation.title: Rebase into current context control
recommendation.body: Keep the idea, but move it into ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer.ts using getContextNoticeViewModel and existing stale-state tests.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev both owns this PR and has prior merged history in the Control UI context-usage surface.
